material_updates.finding: Official indexed Sending Partner listing states Kazakhstan is eligible for full-degree one-tier master studies in any field of interest; therefore previous blanket medicine exclusion was unsupported. General Medicine is a one-tier degree, but availability in 2027/28 for Kazakhstan and exact program/nomination remain unconfirmed. Partner site currently intermittently in maintenance.

Official Kazakhstan guidance: awardees sent under Order 613 must return to Kazakhstan after graduation and work continuously for one year; this does not automatically apply to other scholarship schemes. Kazakhstan nomination is not final university admission.

Government page updated Oct 19 2026: bachelor scholarships restricted to I-III medalists of international school olympiads or international scientific-project contests on an approved list; EndoSim alone does not establish eligibility.
